notes:
T-009 adds `tracenotes check`: it reads the same git log stream as `render` from stdin and reports commits whose header is not Conventional Commits. Ticket: tickets/T-009-check-command.md (also issue https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes/issues/27). Project rules: AGENTS.md rules 1-7 and the quality gate.

Design: src/check.ts `checkGitLog()` is pure and reuses the parser's verdict (`ParsedCommit.conventional`, src/commit.ts:144); merge commits are detected exactly like groupCommits() (`message.raw.startsWith('Merge ')`, src/group.ts:115) because the stream has no parent SHAs. src/cli.ts `check` branch mirrors render's terminal-stdin and empty-stream handling (src/cli.ts render branch), and uses JSON.stringify on the header so control characters print as escapes.

Checks run: `npm run check` passes (typecheck + 310 tests, Windows). Manual: `git log --format=... -20 | node src/cli.ts check` on this repo prints `fail d0b3721 "Journl day 11 update"` and `checked 20: 16 passed, 1 failed, 3 skipped, 0 malformed`, exit 1 (evidence/day12/t009-manual-check-last-20.txt). Not run: Linux (CI will run it).

Known and deliberate: the CLI does not yet print the `skip <short sha> merge commit` lines that criterion 3 asks for, and the merge-only CLI test does not assert them (see decisions).
decisions: Human (Nov 18): any commit type is accepted; only the Conventional Commits header grammar as the existing parser decides it. No allowed-type list.
Human (Nov 18): merge commits are not violations; they are counted and listed as skipped (same detection as T-003).
Human (Nov 18): exit 0 when nothing failed and nothing is malformed, 1 when a commit fails or a record cannot be read, 2 for usage errors, empty stream or terminal stdin.

Human (Nov 18, Day 12 hackathon experiment): the first pull request is a draft with one criterion deliberately left out (criterion 3's skip lines for merge commits), stated in the PR body, to see whether the PR review uses the linked issue. It is fixed before merge.

Agent: `header` is the first line of ParsedCommit.raw (line endings and trailing whitespace already normalized by the parser, AGENTS.md rule 6 framing); the ticket was worded to match before implementation.
recent_work: New feature T-009: src/check.ts, `check` command in src/cli.ts, usage text, README line, BACKLOG row, tests/check.test.ts, CLI child-process cases in tests/cli.test.ts, ticket file and Day 12 evidence.
